title: Fletcher Henderson's arrangements and Goodman's success
summary: Johnston notes Henderson's arrangements made Goodman rich while Henderson died poor.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Talking about arrangers, you know Fletcher Henderson of course arranged for him for so long. And this disadvantage of the arranger is of course that he doesn't make any money after he gets paid initially.
Yes. And of course Benny got rich not only on his own talent but because of some of the success of some of the things that Fletcher Henderson arranged. Fletcher died in poverty.
That's true. Well that's terrible because he was so helpful and Benny Goodman's success really were with those arrangements.
